title: Travel: John Lennon – Aalborg to Paris | 1970
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono flew from Aalborg in Denmark to Paris, France, on 25 January 1970.

They had arrived in Aalborg on 29 December 1969, staying with Ono’s first husband Tony Cox, his new wife Melinda, and Kyoko, Cox and Ono’s six-year-old daughter. Lennon and Ono remained with the Coxes in their farmhouse in Ellidsbølvej over the new year period, leaving Denmark on 25 January 1970.

While there, Lennon and Ono had their long hair cropped. When the news broke, it led to a flurry of press and public interest in their stay, and their departure from Denmark.

They flew from Aalborg Airport to Kastrup Airport near Copenhagen, from where they chartered a private jet to Luton Airport in England. However, poor weather caused the flight to be diverted to Paris, where they stayed for one night at the Paris Hilton hotel.
